purpose: Compare masked sparse reconstruction before and after per-camera colour calibration.

subset.selection: Every fourth image in filename order for each of camera1, camera2, and camera3.

colmap.compute: CPU; installed build reports no CUDA

conclusion: Pass: full registration was preserved; coverage metrics improved modestly while mean reprojection error changed by only 0.00581 px.
limitations: This is a 36-image sparse-SfM regression on one specimen, not a full dense reconstruction benchmark.
Per-image camera intrinsics were used to match the repository wrapper's current configuration.
The result does not establish benefits for other specimens, lighting groups, or final mesh quality.
